name: camayoc_dora_change_steps
description: DORA lead time, decomposed per change (aegis-rb3): for each change MERGED in the window, its opened, first required-checks-green and merge times, from aegis:ChangeEvent. firstGreen is the literal "none" when no required-checks-green result was recorded. Reviews come from camayoc_dora_change_reviews and delivery from camayoc_dora_change_deployed; the reader joins the three on ?change and takes the differences. Only a green inside the change's lifecycle counts (at or after opening, at or before the merge); a green that first arrived after the merge is not a pre-merge green. Graphs are bound up front with VALUES (no per-graph string filter): the current and previous monthly window graphs, plus up to 16 exact staged-backfill graphs. An event older than the previous month is not read; its step reads as none/absent. opened is the literal "none" when no created step is recorded (e.g. a change opened before the producer was armed).
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change (MIN(COALESCE(STR(?openedAt), "none")) AS ?opened) (MIN(COALESCE(STR(?greenAt), "none")) AS ?firstGreen) (MIN(?mergedAt) AS ?merged) WHERE { VALUES ?gm { <{changeNow}> <{changePrev}> <{staging1}> <{staging2}> <{staging3}> <{staging4}> <{staging5}> <{staging6}> <{staging7}> <{staging8}> <{staging9}> <{staging10}> <{staging11}> <{staging12}> <{staging13}> <{staging14}> <{staging15}> <{staging16}> } GRAPH ?gm { ?m a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "merged" ; aegis:occurredAt ?mergedAt . } FILTER(STR(?mergedAt) >= "{start}" && STR(?mergedAt) < "{end}") OPTIONAL { VALUES ?go { <{changeNow}> <{changePrev}> <{staging1}> <{staging2}> <{staging3}> <{staging4}> <{staging5}> <{staging6}> <{staging7}> <{staging8}> <{staging9}> <{staging10}> <{staging11}> <{staging12}> <{staging13}> <{staging14}> <{staging15}> <{staging16}> } GRAPH ?go { ?o a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction "created" ; aegis:occurredAt ?openedAt . } } OPTIONAL { VALUES ?gg { <{changeNow}> <{changePrev}> <{staging1}> <{staging2}> <{staging3}> <{staging4}> <{staging5}> <{staging6}> <{staging7}> <{staging8}> <{staging9}> <{staging10}> <{staging11}> <{staging12}> <{staging13}> <{staging14}> <{staging15}> <{staging16}> } GRAPH ?gg { ?c a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction "ci-passed" ; aegis:occurredAt ?greenAt . } FILTER(STR(?greenAt) <= STR(?mergedAt) && (!BOUND(?openedAt) || STR(?greenAt) >= STR(?openedAt))) } } GROUP BY ?change ORDER BY ?merged

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo

params.name: start
params.description: window start, RFC 3339 UTC (inclusive)

params.name: end
params.description: window end, RFC 3339 UTC (exclusive)

params.name: changeNow
params.description: change window graph for the window's end month, e.g. https://camayoc.local/window/change/2026-10

params.name: changePrev
params.description: change window graph for the month before changeNow

params.name: staging1
params.description: an exact reviewed staged-backfill graph (aegis-rb3 B2); unused slots carry an IRI with no data, e.g. urn:quipu:import:staging:none
